subject: Draft: Serving + Platform team realignment — QBR talking points & cascade plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Serving + Platform team realignment — QBR talking points & cascade plan

Team,

Attached is a working draft (realignment-draft-v2.docx) of the proposed scope changes between Serving and Platform. High level summary:

- Create two adjacent org buckets: "Serving Core" (runtime, inference optimizations, model routing) and "Platform Infrastructure" (deployment, orchestration, infra automation).
- Move two IC-heavy squads (KV Cache & Batching) into Serving Core; shift long-lived infra projects (deployment orchestration, private deployment packaging) into Platform Infrastructure.
- Define transition owners and a 6-week runway for pair-programming and knowledge transfer (May 17 — Jun 27).
- Draft comms for managers + QBR talking points included in the doc.

Key asks: please review with an eye for (1) manager-level messaging (what to tell teams on day 1), (2) oncall and coverage risk during transition, and (3) any blockers that should pause public comms.

I want to lock the exec readout slides by EOD May 14 so we can publish manager memos the morning after the QBR. See attached qbr-slide-deck-v3.pptx and comp-impact-summary.xlsx for headcount/comp impacts.

Please send short comments (inline or email) by EOD May 11 if you have anything that would materially change the plan. I can incorporate and circulate a consolidated version for sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to sharp, pragmatic feedback.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Platform & Serving
Redwood Inference

Attachments: realignment-draft-v2.docx (document), qbr-slide-deck-v3.pptx (slides), comp-impact-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Serving + Platform team realignment — QBR talking points & cascade plan

Karthik — thanks for the clear outline. Two quick notes from my side: 

1) Coverage: we need an explicit oncall overlap plan for the first 2 weeks of the runway. The KV Cache squad has three primary oncall owners; shifting them mid-rotation will create risk. Can we call out who will backfill and how escalations flow?

2) Comms: the manager memo feels long. For QBR and the manager cascade I'd recommend a short one-pager (bullet: what changes, why, what to expect this week) plus an FAQ for managers. I updated slide 4 of the deck with a condensed headline and linked it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c_realignment_draft (commented).

Also small ask: include explicit guidance to people managers about career+comp conversations; if we don't handle that proactively we'll get a lot of one-off inquiries.

Happy to take the owner for the internal FAQ draft if you want me to.

— Lauren
Director, People & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Serving + Platform team realignment — QBR talking points & cascade plan

Karthik / team — I reviewed the draft and lean into the proposed split. A few concrete asks before I can green-light the manager memo: 

- Headcount & comp impacts: I made notes in comp-impact-summary.xlsx. Need final numbers for FTE moves vs. net hires to ensure budget and recruiting alignment.
- Customer impact list: please add a short list of 3 highest-risk customer-facing flows that could see transient regressions during transition (we should proactively flag to CS).
- Manager FAQ: agree with Lauren that an FAQ is required; happy to co-author with Lauren.

I updated the deck with a "risk & mitigations" slide. I also added a suggested script for the QBR readout (slide 7).

On a tactical note: if we're shifting squads between reporting lines, let's confirm the effective date for comp/title changes (if any). That determines what HR needs to publish.

— Marissa
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Serving + Platform team realignment — QBR talking points & cascade plan

Karthik / all — good work. High-level guidance from the exec desk:

- Messaging: tie the reorg to QBR themes: reliability, predictability of inference economics, and enterprise readiness. Make the customer/SLAs angle front-and-center so the org understands the why beyond structure.
- Timing: I approve the May 17 start of the transition workstreams and the 6-week runway. However — hold public manager-level comms until we get final exec sign-off after the readout on May 14. We should not cascade until we confirm comp impacts and final owner matrix.
- Transition owners: please list a named owner (PM, Eng manager) for each major migration task. I want clear SROs in the runbook.

Also recommend a short one-slide "what success looks like" metric set for the QBR: latency distribution, per-token cost delta, and deployment MTTR. If we can show expected numbers it will reduce follow-up questions.

I'll give final sign-off on the slides right after the readout.

— Jonas
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

- Added explicit oncall overlap plan and transition owners (see section 3 of the doc).

- Logged a tracking ticket SUP-3421 for execution tasks and runbook items: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421.

- Jonas: executive sign-off at readout tomorrow (May 15 - QBR). Please confirm approval post-readout and we'll schedule the manager cascade for May 16 morning.
- Marissa & Lauren: finalize FAQ and comp comms by EOD May 15 so HR can prepare letters.
- I'll coordinate a 30-minute leadership rehearsal (Thu May 20 10:00–10:30 AM PT) — invite to follow.

If there are no blocking questions I'll circulate the public manager memo the morning of May 16.

Thanks — Karthik

Redwood Inference
